title: Schedule of Cancellation Terms — KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans
content:
The cancellation terms of KestrelCare Prepaid Maintenance Plans are identical at all six plan levels, from KestrelCare Maintenance Starter to KestrelCare Maintenance Premier Max. This schedule states the figures and settings those terms use.

## Schedule

| Term | Every plan level |
|---|---|
| Free look: calendar days after the sale date within which an unused plan is refunded in full | 30 |
| Cancellation fee deducted from a refund outside the free look (USD) | 25.00 |
| How a refund outside the free look is computed | Unused-visit share of the plan price |
| Cancellation reasons refunded in full with no fee | Vehicle returned |
| Business days after cancellation within which the refund is issued | 30 |
| Refund of a financed plan goes to the lienholder while the finance contract is active | Yes |
| Minimum refund: a computed refund below this amount is not issued (USD) | 10.00 |

## Notes to the schedule

1. The free look runs for 30 calendar days counted from the plan's sale date and applies to a plan that is still unused.
2. The fee of 25.00 is deducted only from a refund that is not a free-look refund; a cancellation for the reason "vehicle returned" is refunded in full with no fee.
3. The unused-visit share is the part of the plan price that corresponds to the visits not yet used, out of the visits included.
4. The 30 business days are counted after the cancellation; the 30 calendar days of the free look are counted after the sale date. The two figures are equal but are counted from different dates and in different kinds of days.
5. The minimum of 10.00 applies to the computed refund: an amount below 10.00 is not issued.
